Commentary.Commentary: So that is it from this game! There are still three more matches to go though. The next one will be played on the 14th of May at 1300 local (1200 GMT). Will Pakistan level the series or will England take an unassailable lead? We'll have to wait to find out. Till then take care and goodbye!
Jos Buttler has been awarded the Man of the Match for his scintillating 110* off just 55 balls.

So just like we mentioned in the first innings, not a lot can be said about a team which concedes above 350. However, there is a stand out for the hosts and it was David Willey. It was probably his spell towards the end which won the game for them. On a day where most of the bowlers went for more than 6 per over, he went at under it and got two crucial wickets.

After Buttler's magnificent ton and handful contributions from the English top order, the hosts managed to get to a total which all thought England would defend quite easily. That was not the case though. The Pakistan openers got their team off to a brilliant start. Imam fell but Babar Azam then continued with Zaman. The right-hander got to yet another fifty and Zaman got to a brilliant ton. When the two were batting, Pakistan were favourites. However, they fell in quick succession and then a collapse seemed on the cards. Asif Ali, who got a life at the very start of his innings, struck some lusty blows. He along with his skipper, got his team back into the game. They needed 53 in the last 5 overs but wickets at regular intervals and some brilliant bowling ensured it is the hosts who finish on top.

WOW! Amazing game! A complete run fest. It is England who came out on top in the end but Pakistan surely gave them a run for their money. At once, it also seemed they would get over the line but some exceptional death bowling saw the hosts take a 1-0 lead in the series.
A single to end! Top delivery once again. A yorker on middle, Hasan jams it down to long on and a single is taken. Customary handshakes taking place as ENGLAND WIN BY 12 RUNS!
A dot now! 14 needed from the last ball. Full and wide outside off, it is the perfect full length delivery outside off, just inside the tramline. Hasan lets it be. He wants a wide but it is not one.
Just a single which means, if England do not bowl an extra, they will win it. Full and outside off, it is carved out to sweeper cover for a single.
A dot! Worst thing for Pakistan. It is just inside the tramline on the off side. Sarfaraz goes after it but misses. 15 in 3, the next ball has to go.

Outside off and full again, Hasan swings but it goes off the bottom towards a very fine short third man. A single. A little to the left or the right and it would have been a boundary. 15 in 4, need a boundary do Pakistan.
WIDE! Outside the tramline on the off side and it has been wided.
Full outside off, Hasan Ali swings his bat at it. He does not time it well. It falls short of long off and they get a couple. 17 off 5 needed now.
Chris Woakes to bowl the final over.
Just the couple to end! Shorter and on off, Sarfaraz flat-bats it over mid off and takes two. Just the 8 from the over, 18 needed in the last one. However, it is Hasan who will be on strike.
The new man in is Hasan Ali.

OUT! Plunkett gets another. A very full delivery on off, Faheem hits it high up in the air towards mid off where Stokes calls for it and then takes it. He may not have been expecting the short one there and hence, could not get the timing.
Pakistan are dealing in singles when boundary is the need of the hour. Continues bowling it short, it is pulled through mid-wicket for one.
Just a single again! England won't mind this at all. Short and on the body. Faheem looks to pull but it goes off the higher portion of the bat and towards fine leg for one.

In the air... but safe! A short ball on middle, Sarfaraz fails to get on top of the bounce, he only gets a top edge but it lands safe towards deep square leg. They go for the second. Willey throws it to the keeper who looks to flick it onto the stumps but misses. There is no one backing up so they take the third.
Just a single to begin with! Full and outside off, the batsman looks to drive it through the off side but it goes off the inner half towards the leg side for one.
Liam Plunkett to bowl the all important 49th over.

DOT! Another top over. Just the five runs and a wicket from it. A full toss outside off, Sarfaraz looks to put bat on ball but misses. 27 now needed in 12 balls. Willey's spell comes to an end, a match-winning spell one can say. He has gone for 57 in his 10 and taken two crucial wickets.
Goes short again, Ashraf upper cuts it towards third man for only another single. Pakistan need boundaries, singles won't do them any good.
Very full and outside off, Sarfaraz looks to go over covers but it goes off the inner half towards mid off for one.
Faheem Ashraf walks out to bat next.

OUT! Willey's exceptional spell continues! He bounces out Imad Wasim. A short one and it is on the body of Wasim. He is cramped for room as he looks to pull. The ball goes off the top edge and towards the third man region. Buttler runs there and takes it with a dive forward. A brilliant catch under pressure by Buttler.
Low full toss outside off, Sarfaraz just hits it towards third man for a run.
Full length ball outside off, Sarfaraz hits it wide of deep cover and runs the first one hard. He straightaway calls for two and gets it.

SIX! BANG! 17 from the over. A huge one, exactly what Pakistan needed. They are right back in it now. 32 in 18. The googly and it is outside off, Imad smacks it right of the middle and over the long on fence.
just a single now as this is miscued towards long off.
Another couple! This is short and on middle, Ahmed goes back and pulls it powerfully through mid-wicket. Two taken.

Excellent fielding! The two runs saved by JB could be crucial here. Sarfaraz makes room and guides it past point. Jonny runs to his left in the deep and then with a dive pushes it back in. They go upstairs to check and replays show that he has done really well.

FOUR! Brilliant from Sarfaraz! He makes room and Rashid bowls the googly on off, it turns back in. Sarfaraz goes against the turn, inside out and over covers for a boundary. 6 from the first two. This has to be a big over.
Dances down the track and powers it past the bowler for a brace.
A dot to end a top class over from Willey. Just the 4 runs and the big wicket from it. A short one on off, Imam looks to upper cut but misses.

Overthrow! Bonus runs for England and they would need them. This is slapped towards mid off. Plunkett there dives to his right and stops it. He throws it towards the bowler off balance. It is a wayward one. Willey fails to collect it and an extra run is taken. Two in total.
The new man in is Imad Wasim.

OUT! Ali holes out. This over keeps getting better for the hosts. Just 2 from the first three balls and now the wicket of the dangerous Ali. Very full and on off, Ali looks to go over long off this time but does not get the desired elevation. It goes straight to Stokes who takes it and then tumbles onto the ground. 51 in 26 needed and only the bowling all-rounders to come. Asif Ali's wicket was probably the one which turns the tide completely into England's favour.
Swing and a miss! This is full and wide outside off. Ali looks to go over long on but misses.
A couple now! Brings up Asif's fifty. He holds the key here for Pakistan. Can he take them over the line? He gets to the milestone by strokes it wide of long off.

Just short! A yorker outside off, Asif Ali looks to jam it out but misses. Buttler seems to have taken it on the bounce. Actually that had been taken but the sound there was of the bat hitting the ground and not the ball. A dot though.
The last ball is a dot! So 8 from the over. The slider and on the stumps, Sarfaraz cuts but finds point who was brought in a couple of balls ago.
Another couple! This is worked with soft hands towards mid-wicket and the batters take two. So without much risk taken, this over has gone for 8 and a ball still to go.
Makes room again this time, Rashid fires it on middle, it is guided past point for a brace.
Brings out the sweep, beats short fine leg. The man in the deep runs to his right and keeps it down to two.
The slider on the pads, it is worked towards short fine leg for one.

That was outrageous! Sarfaraz almost hits it onto his own stumps. He makes a lot, a lot of room there. Rashid follows him. He then guides it. The ball goes very close past the leg pole and down to short third man for one.
Adil Rashid is back on.
Another top yorker to end! It is outside off, Ali once again fails to put bat on ball. So despite the biggie, only 8 from the over. 61 more needed in 36.
Looks to be cheeky but does not come off! Shuffles right across and tries to paddle but the ball is way too outside off. It ends up going between Asif's legs.
Good running! Another low full toss outside off, it is carved towards deep point. They take one, then go for the second and complete it.
A low full toss outside off, just inside the tramline. Asif looks to put bat on ball but misses.

SIX! Pounded over the fence! Not sure what Willey was bowling here. With mid on and mid off up, that was in the slot, full and on off. Ali says thank you very much and powers it over the long off fence. Pakistan favourites now. 63 of 40.
A yorker outside off, Ali jams it out to mid off.
David Willey is back on!
On the shorter side, Ali pulls it all along the ground to deep square leg for a single. 9 from the over, Pakistan going along well here.
FOUR! There comes the boundary they need every over! Full and wide outside off, it is carved over point and the ball races away to the fence.
Fuller in length on middle, it is driven to mid on. 300 up for Pakistan.
A dot now! Gold dust at this stage! Short and on the body, Sarfaraz pulls but straight to mid on.
WIDE! Short and outside off, it bounces too high and a wide has been signaled.
Another short one and on the body, Ali looks to pull but does not time it that well. A single to fine leg. Two singles to begin this over. Singles won't harm England.
On the shorter side, Sarfaraz pulls it towards mid on for a single.

Good fielding! That could have easily been a boundary. A poor ball, it is short and down the leg side with fine leg up. Sarfaraz works it to that region where Root runs to his right and stops it with a slide. Still 13 from the over, 78 needed in 48.
A single now! This is whipped through the leg side towards deep mid-wicket. Willey runs around and fumbles but no extra run conceded.
FOUR! This is turning out be a very expensive over. 11 from it with two balls to go. It is the slower one and outside off, Ali slaps it past mid on and the ball races away.
Second wide of the over! This one is for a delivery which is way outside off.
A single now so that means 6 from the first three balls as it is guided down to third man.
FOUR! In the gap! Length and on middle, Sarfaraz pulls it in the gap in the mid-wicket region for a much-needed boundary. 5 from the first two balls, they need to make this over count now.
WIDE! Short and outside off, Sarfaraz lets it be and it has been called a wide for height.
Length and around off, Ahmed slaps it back to the bowler. A dot to begin!

Poor from Buttler. Woakes bowls a beautiful slower bouncer. Asif looks to hit it over third man but misses. The ball bounces in front of Buttler and he misreads the bounce and it goes away. The fielder in the deep runs to his right and saves it from going to the fence with a dive. They take a couple. Byes signalled by the umpire.
Bouncer on off and middle, Sarfaraz pulls it away. 5 singles on the trot.
On the body of Asif, he pulls it to deep mid-wicket and gets to the other end.
Good length ball on middle, SA defends it with soft hands and runs through for a single.
Slower bouncer on off, Asif pulls it away towards deep mid-wicket and rotates the strike.
On the pads, Sarfaraz glances it down to fine leg and gets a single.
Powerplay 3 signalled by the umpire. Now 5 fielders can be placed outside the inner circle till the end of the game. Also, Chris Woakes back for another spell.
A dot to end! Brilliant over by Plunkett. Probably the momentum changing one. 2 runs and a wicket from it. The slower ball outside off, Ali slaps it uppishly but on the bounce to mid off.
Inside edge but safe! Sarfraz says enough of blocking, he clears his front leg and then looks for the hoick over the leg side but only manages an inside edge towards the leg side for a single.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Back of a length on off, Sarfaraz guides it to point.
A little too straight, it is clipped towards fine leg for one.
Skipper, Sarfaraz Ahmed is the new man in.

OUT! Top edge... taken! Plunkett strikes with his first ball of his new spell. Just what the doctor ordered for England. A partnership forming between the two batters and it has been cut short just at the right time. This is banged in short and around off,  Sohail looks to slap it but ends up slicing it towards Bairstow at sweeper cover who takes an easy catch. 100 more needed in 65 balls.
Liam Plunkett is on now!
Tossed up on off, Harris comes down the track and hits it over covers, The outfield is slow so it does not get to the fence. They run three.
Flighted on middle and leg, Ali strokes it to long on for a run.
On off and middle, Haris sweeps it away to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Tossed up on off, Haris hits it over covers. Wide of the man in the deep for a couple.
Almost a soft dismissal. Floated on middle, Haris looks to drive but then goes for the push. He chips it but it falls short of Moeen.
Floated on off, Haris comes down the track and hits it hard but the man at cover gets down and saves the ball from going to the fence.
Another single to end another top over for Pakistan. This is eased down to long on for a run.
Flatter and down the leg side, Ali looks to flick but it goes off the pads towards short fine leg. A leg bye.
Sohail strokes it through covers for one.

DROPPED! That should have been taken. Willey is the culprit. This could prove a big let off. Rashid is not a happy man and rightly so. This is tossed up on off, this is a little too full. Ali goes for it again but does not get underneath it. He ends up hitting it flat towards long off. Willey runs in and tries to take it with a dive forward but spills it.
Clever bowling! Pushes it through and outside off, Ali is a touch late in the shot as he tries to cut. Gets beaten.
SIX! That is colossal! Ideal start to the over and pressure is now on the bowler. This is tossed up on middle, it is a little too full. Ali sends it sailing into the long on stand.
Another single and 12 comes from the over. This is worked through mid-wicket. 117 needed in 78.
Haris strokes it down to long off and takes one. Clever batting.
This is worked through mid-wicket for one.

SIX! Not quite off the middle but it goes all the way. Asif Ali uses his feet and goes with the turn, does not time it all that well but gets enough to clear the long on fence. Ali managing to ease the pressure here with these hits.
Plays the sweep and plays it nicely towards backward square leg for a couple.
This is eased down to long off for one.
A dot to end! Ali goes back and keeps it out.
SIX! Going, going and gone! This guy bags a punch. It is tossed up on off, Ali goes down on one knee and slog sweeps it over the mid-wicket fence. Releases all the pressure.
This is worked around the corner for a single.
Just short! On the off pole, Sohail goes back and looks to punch it but does it on the bounce to covers.
Dances down the track but Rashid shortens his length, it is defended.
Tosses it on off, Sohail strokes it to covers.
WIDE! Down the leg side and it has been wided.
Floated on middle and leg, Sohail strokes it to long on and keeps the strike.
Flighted on middle and leg, Asif sweeps it to square leg and gets a run after two consecutive dots.
On middle and leg, Ali tucks it to the man at mid-wicket.
Short on middle and leg, Asif punches it to the man at cover.
Shorter on middle and leg, Haris strokes it to long on. Moeen tries to stop it with a dive but misses and they get a single.
Tossed up on off, Haris comes down the track and blocks it.
Moeen Ali is back.

The batsman gets a leading edge on that one. They pick up a single. A wicket from this over as well. The last two overs went for 14 and England have managed to get rid of the centurion and the half centurion.
Haris Sohail is the new man in.

OUT! Caught and bowled! Both the set batsmen are out of here. Just what England wanted and not what Pakistan would have wanted. A lucky dismissal to be honest this one. It is a nothing delivery, it is very short and on off, it skids through. Azam goes back and looks to drag his pull but the ball hits the higher portion of the bat and lobs back to the bowler who accepts a dolly. Two wickets in quick succession have put Pakistan totally on the back foot here.
The googly around off, Ali goes back and pushes it to covers.
A single now as Azam works this full ball to mid-wicket.

Another couple as he works it in the gap in the mid-wicket region. Brings up yet another fifty in this format. A real run machine in ODIs for Pakistan. He raises his bat to soak in the applause but he knows there is still a long way to go.
Shorter and outside off, it is slapped through covers for a single.
Asif Ali walks out at number 4.

OUT! That is right off the toe-end of the bat. Excellent, excellent review from Morgan. The magnificent innings by Fakhar Zaman has come to an end and England will be relieved as he was taking the game away from them. Woakes continues bowling it way too wide outside off, this one was very wide just inside the tramline though. Zaman still tries to reach it but there is a noise as the ball passes the bat. Buttler collects it and just puts in a muted appeal. Woakes though thinks there is something and he puts in a loud appeal. Morgan then reviews. Replays roll in and they show a spike on Ultra Edge. The English players are pumped up. England back on top now. 147 needed in 102.
Review time! An appeal for a caught behind has been turned down. Morgan has reviewed. There was a sound there.
A yorker outside off, it is jammed out to point.
FOUR! Clever, very clever from Zaman, also, cheeky. Zaman right at the end, shuffles right across and then paddle scoops it over short fine leg for a boundary.
Very full and outside off, this is hit to the man at covers. Zaman going after everything here.

Almost gets done in by the spin there! A full toss outside off, Zaman drives it towards deep point. The ball bounces and then spins towards the wrong side of the fielder. He though does well to stop himself and stop it. Two taken.
Babar opens the face of the bat and guides it to third man. Gives the strike to Zaman. Does the right thing.
Floated on off, Fakhar after getting two boundaries on the trot defends it to see off the over.
FOUR! This is such a sensible batting from Zaman. The mid off is up so he comes down the track and hits it over the man there for a boundary.
FOUR! Swept and swept hard. Tossed up outside off, Zaman sweeps it hard through square leg for a boundary.
Floated on off, Azam nudges it towards cover and gets a single.
Floated on off, Azam hits it wide of point and gets another two.
WIDE! Rashid sprays it down the leg side, Babar leaves it alone. Wide signalled.
Flighted on off, Babar comes down the track and hits it straight to mid on.
Adil Rashid is back into the attack.
Full on off, Fakhar strokes it wide of sweeper cover once again and gets couple to finish off the over. 14 runs off this over. 31 runs have come off the last 3.
Full outside off, Zaman strokes it wide of sweeper cover and gets a couple.
FOUR! What a shot! The fine leg was inside the circle. Woakes bowls it full outside off, Zaman premeditates the scoop and gets it over short fine leg for a boundary.
Good length on off, Babar runs it down to third man and gets a single. 200 comes up for Pakistan. They need another 174 runs to win this game.
Full toss outside off, Zaman hits it to deep cover and gets a single. Smart batting this.
FOUR! Woakes comes in and bangs it in short, Zaman was expecting it and he pulls it away over square leg for a boundary. England need to change this tactic here. This is clearly not working.
Chris Woakes is back into the attack.
Oh close! Length ball outside off, Babar looks to tap it towards point but misses. The ball was very close from finding the outside edge.
On off and short, Zaman pulls it away to deep mid-wicket for a run.
FOUR! Slower delivery hammered away by Zaman. It is on off, in Fakhar's slot. He clears his front foot and smashes it over mid off for a boundary. The partnership also gets to 100 with that.
On off, Zaman strokes it to mid off.
Good length ball middle and off, Babar looks to pull it but gets hit high on the knee roll. The ball goes towards third man for a leg bye.
Full on middle, Fakhar strokes it wide of mid off and gets a single.
Short again, Zaman pulls it away wide of mid-wicket for a couple.
On the pads, Fakhar tucks it to the leg side for a run.
The batsman has punched the ball off the backfoot. They pick up a single.
Outside off on a length, Zaman pulls it away on the on side for a run.

Excellent fielding in the deep from Adil Rashid.  Back of a length ball on off, Babar guides it wide of third man. Rashid runs from third man and stops the ball from going to the fence with a dive. The batsmen comeback for the third.
Full and on the pads, Azam works it towards fine leg for a couple.
And now a couple! Short and on middle, Zaman pulls it towards fine leg for a couple. 9 from the over, exactly the rate they need to go at.
Azam now waits for it and then guides it down to third man for a single.
FOUR! He has timed that to perfection! On the pads, Azam works it right off the middle and through backward square leg for a boundary. Runs coming easily for the visitors.
This is on the pads, it is worked through mid-wicket for one.
A short one on middle, Zaman pulls it to deep mid-wicket.
Full and outside off, this is driven through point for a single.
Ben Stokes is introduced into the attack.

100 for Fakhar Zaman. This has been a special knock from him but the job is not yet done and he knows it. Good length ball on off, Zaman drives it wide of sweeper cover for a couple to get to his 4th ODI ton. He removes his helmet and raises his bat as the crowd here in Southampton rise to the feet and give him a round of applause for his innings. There were some criticism and doubts regarding his form but he has answered his critics.
Length ball on off, Fakhar loosk to hit it but gets a bottom edge to the keeper.
FOUR! Moves to 98. The length is once again short and Fakhar has had no problem playing the pull shot. He hoicks it over mid on for a boundary.
Back of a length ball on off, this time Babar pulls it to deep mid-wicket and rotates the strike.
Full on middle and off, Zaman tucks it to mid on and gets a run.
Full on off, Fakhar strokes it towards the bowler. Plunkett mimes to throw it at the keeper's end but he does not.
Fuller on middle and leg, Azam glances it to the man at mid-wicket.
Short on off, Zaman once again plays the pull shot. This time to mid-wicket for a run.
Good length on off, Azam tucks it to mid-wicket and gets a run.
On off, Fakhar pulls it away to the on side and rotates the strike.
On middle and off, Babar tucks it to the on side and gets a run.
Short on the body, Zaman pulls it towards fine leg and gets to the other end.
Length on off, Fakhar pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a run. Into the 90's now.

A very well disguised slower bouncer there. It is outside off, Zaman goes for the pull but completely misses it. Buttler gets it on a bounce but cannot take it the first time. It does not cost any extra run though.
On off, Babar runs it down to third man and takes an easy single.
Good stop from the skipper. Full on off, Babar drives it hard but Morgan gets down and stops the ball on his right.
Full on off, Fakhar hits it to mid off and gets a run.
Length ball on off, Fakhar hits it straight to cover.
Outside off, Babar strokes it wide of deep cover and gets a couple.
Full on off, Babar drives it straight to mid off.
Length ball on off, once again Fakhar pulls it with ease to deep mid-wicket and rotates the strike.
Quick single. Full on off, Azam strokes it wide of mid off and gets a quick run.
Good length ball on off, Fakhar pulls it hard to deep square leg for a run. He has scored most of his runs on the on side today.
On the pads, Azam flicks it to fine leg and gets a run.
In the air but safe. Back of a length ball on off, Fakhar looks to pull it but gets a top edge. It flies wide of third man. Rashid cannot get there and they take two.
Bouncer! The batsman ducks in time to let that one go over him.
Excellent fielding! Back of a length ball on off, Zaman pulls it hard wide of deep mid-wicket. Bairstow runs to his left and stops the ball from going to the fence. Saves two for his side.
Ouch! That must've hurt. Shorter in length, Fakhar looks to pull but gets hit right on the grill of his helmet.
SIX! Swings and swings hard. Brings up the 50 partnership between the two. Full on middle and leg, Fakhar clears his front leg and deposits it over the square leg fence for a biggie.
Full on off, Fakhar hits it to the man at mid off.
Liam Plunkett back on.
Outside off, Azam looks to hit it on the off side but misses.
length ball on the pads. It moves away after pitching. Babar looks to defend but does so off the upper half of his bat.
This time pulls it wide of the man there and gets a single.
Back of a length ball outside off, Fakhar pulls it to the man at mid-wicket.
Length ball on off, Babar runs it down to third man and gets a single.
Betters his line and bowls it on off, Babar blocks it and shouts a loud no.
WIDE! Willey bowls it on a length down the leg side, Babar looks to flick it but misses.
David Willey is back on.
A single to end! This is pulled through square leg for a single. 8 from the over but it is still below the runs needed per over.
The batsman defends it from within the crease. One run added to the total.
FOUR! Gets the boundary! They need to keep finding the fence regularly. Steps down the track and then drags his shot between the gap in the mid-wicket region. Boundary.
Zaman looking for a boundary, makes room and then tries to hit it through the off side but misses.
A short one and on middle, Azam fails to take full toll of it as he pulls it to deep mid-wicket only for a run. Boundaries hard to come by at the moment.
Zaman uses his feet and then strokes it down to long off for a run.
The slider on off, Azam defends it out. Just three from the over. A good one for England.
Azam dances down the track but yorks himself. He ends up jamming it onto his own boot.
The googly, Zaman works it against the turn through square leg for a single.
Another single through the covers from the bat of Babar this time.
Outside off, it is pushed through covers for one.
The leg spinner but the line is a little too straight. Zaman looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads.

Almost chops it on! Zaman makes room and Moeen bowls it quicker on off. FZ goes for the cut but the ball was too close to play that shot. He gets an inside edge which goes close past the leg pole, down to short fine leg for a single.
Zaman uses his feet and then powers it back towards the bowler. Moeen does well to stop it with one hand. Does not do so cleanly but does not allow any runs to be taken.
Flatter and around off, Azam goes back and pushes it through covers for one.
Another single but this time down to long off and off the bat of Zaman.
A single as this is pushed down to long on.
A brace! Short and outside off, Azam goes back and slaps it through covers. Two taken.
Slows it up on middle, Zaman was looking for a big shot but then due to the dip, he pushes it back to the bowler.
The googly on off, Azam does not pick it. He then adjusts and works it through mid-wicket for one.
Slower through the air on off, it is guided through point for another brace.
A couple now! On the leg side, Babar works it through square leg and takes two.
Flatter and on middle, it is pushed towards cover for one.
Uses his feet and then strokes it down to long off for one.
SIX! Zaman has nailed that! Makes room and Moeen follows him. FZ is down on one knee and smashes it into the mid-wicket stand. Spoils the over, 12 from it.
Dances down the track and looks to work it as he does not get to the pitch of the ball. Misses, gets hit on the pads and the ball rolls towards third man for a run. Leg bye given.
Uses his feet and hits it all along the ground down to long on for a single.
Fires it on off, Azam taps it towards cover and takes a quick single.
Just outside off, Azam stays leg side and guides it past point for a brace. 100 up for the visitors.
This is pushed down to long on for a single.
A single to end a tight over. Short and outside off, Zaman slaps it through covers for one.
Zaman goes for the reverse sweep to this googly but there is extra bounce. It hits the glove and then onto the helmet.
Tossed up on middle, it is worked to mid-wicket.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot. They pick up a single.
Tosses it up on off, Azam defends it to covers.
On the pads, it is worked through square leg for a single.
Another single as this is flicked through square leg. End of a successful over for the hosts.
This time he waits for it and flicks it through square leg. Gets off the mark.
On the shorter side, Azam goes back and keeps it out.
On the off pole, Azam blocks it out.
Babar Azam is the new man in.

OUT! Moeen Ali strikes! A soft, soft dismissal but England will be delighted. A much-needed wicket for the hosts as this partnership looked threatening. Moeen slows it up a little and it comes slower off the wicket. Imam looks to work it against the turn. His bat though turns a little too early. He ends up chipping it back to the bowler who takes a good low catch. Imam walks back after getting a start but was part of a good stand with Zaman. 282 more needed.
Fires it on the leg pole, it is pushed down to long on for a single.
Short on off, Zaman punches it to deep cover for a run. 7 off Adil's first.
Shorter on middle and off, Imam milks it to long on and gets a run.
On middle and leg, Zaman glances it towards mid-wicket and gets to the other end.
Fifty for Fakhar Zaman. His 10th ODI fifty. He has played well but needs to carry on. He gets to this milestone by glancing the ball wide of fine leg for a couple.
On the pads, Fakhar tucks it to fine leg and gets a couple.
Starts with a lovely flighted googly on middle, Fakhar blocks it.
Bowling change. Adil Rashid is being introduced into the attack now.
A dot to end a good over for the visitors. On the middle pole, it is defended.
Sensible batting as a single is taken down to long off.
SIX! That should release all the pressure building. Zaman says enough of making room, he steps down and whacks it over the long on fence.
Once again follows Zaman and cramps him for room. FZ pushes it back to the bowler.
Good fielding and bowling! Sees Zaman making room and follows him. Zaman pushes it to the right of the bowler who makes a good diving stop. Saves a single.
Works it with the angle to mid-wicket.
A yorker on off, it is jammed towards mid off for a quick run.
Short again and outside off, Zaman guides it to point.
Full and on off, this is driven through covers for one.
Bangs it short and on the body, Zaman pulls it towards deep square leg for one.
Good running! This is on the pads again, Zaman looks to flick but gets an inside edge onto his pads. The ball rolls towards square leg and the batsmen take two.
On the hip of the batsman, Imam looks to pull but it hits the thigh pad and rolls towards fine leg. A leg bye taken.
Ends the over with a floated delivery on middle and leg. Imam tucks it away to square leg and keeps the strike.
On the pads, Imam finds the man at mid-wicket with his flick.
Flighted on middle and leg, Fakhar comes down the track and nudges it to long on for a single.
Floated on middle and off, Fakhar moves away from the ball and looks to hit it to the off side but gets an inside edge which goes to short fine leg.
WIDE! Sprays it down the leg side, Imam looks to flick it but misses. Buttler fails to gather it and they take a run as the ball goes towards short fine leg.
Quicker on the pads, Imam just blocks it.
On the pads, Fakhar flicks it towards mid-wicket and gets to the other end.
Powerplay 2 signalled by the umpire. Now 4 fielders can be placed outside the 30-yard circle till the 40th over.
Full on off, Imam gets on his front foot and blocks it.
Better line and length this. He needs to continue to bowl it there. Full outside off, Imam leaves it alone.
Changes his length but not the line. He bowls it full, Imam flicks it wide of fine leg and gets two once again.
On the pads, Imam glances it towards square leg for a couple.
On the pads now, Fakhar tucks it towards mid-wicket and gets to the other end.
Starts with a good length delivery on middle, Fakhar hits it straight back to Liam.
Liam Plunkett is into the attack now.
On the pads once again, Imam flicks it again but this time to the man at square leg.
Zaman takes a single this time by nudging it on the leg side.
Fires it on middle, it is defended out.
Goes deep in the crease again and works it towards backward square leg for one.
This is fired on the pads, Imam goes back and works it behind square on the leg side. Two taken.
Flatter and on middle, Imam lunges forward and defends it onto the ground.
Spinner introduced into the attack. Moeen Ali replaces Chris Woakes.
On the pads again, this is worked through mid-wicket for one. 11 from the over and 24 from the last two. 317 needed in 252.
FOUR! Another over which consists of two boundaries! Once again a poor ball, short and width on offer outside off, it is cut through point and the ball races away.
Back of a length and on middle, Imam blocks it off the back foot.
Mohammad Hasnain is on the field with a new bat for Imam-ul-Haq.
FOUR! Easy pickings there! 50 up for the visitors and it has come up in quick time. Short and down the leg side, poor ball with short fine leg up. Imam helps it on its way to the fine leg fence.
A slower one, Zaman may not have read it. He had to check his shot. It goes towards the bowler who does not field it properly and a run is taken.
A quick single! Not only are the boundaries important but these quick singles are equally useful. This is pushed towards mid off and Imam gets to the other end.
FOUR! A biggie and a boundary to end this over! 13 from it. The slower bouncer on the pads, it is pulled through square leg and the ball races away to the fence. Pakistan are off to a flier.
SIX! Stand and deliver! That has gone all the way, first of this innings. Fuller in length and on off, Zaman clears his front leg and tonks it over the long on fence.
In the 5th stump channel, Imam plays it late and down towards third man. The batsmen cross ends.
Another quick run! On middle, Zaman flicks it towards mid-wicket.
This time gets bat to it, it is played with an open face so it runs down to third man for a single.

Brilliant delivery! Gets this one to zip off the surface, bowls it on a back of a length and around off. It also angles away. Imam hangs his bat out but luckily for him, it does not take the outside edge.
A dot to end! Length and outside off, the batter shoulders arms to it.
Bangs this one short again, Imam waits for it and then guides it down to third man for one.

Good fielding! Saves a run for his side. This is shorter and on middle, Zaman pulls it through mid-wicket. It slows down as it reaches the boundary. Stokes from square leg makes a lot of ground to his right, then dives and keeps it down to three.
Gets this one to rise too from a length around off, Imam hangs back and guides it down to third man for a single.
Good pace there! Willey bends his back on this one and bangs it short on middle, Imam looks for the pull but is beaten for pace.
Short and outside off, Imam hops and looks to cut but fails to put bat on ball.
FOUR! End of another productive over for the visitors. Zaman steps out and hits it hard past mid on. Second boundary in the over. This is a good positive start for the tourists.
Goes back to bowling it on off, Zaman pushes it to covers. The openers are timing it well here.
FOUR! Smacked! Picks the length of the short ball early and then pulls it with power through mid-wicket and it races away to the fence.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
On the fuller around off, Zaman goes after it but he does not time it well, it goes towards mid off.
Shortish and on middle, this is pulled through mid-wicket for a brace.
A good change in length there! Bangs it short and on middle, Imam ducks under it. A good over this for Pakistan, 8 from it.
A solid punch but to the fielder! Back of a length on off, it is guided to point.
Another length ball and outside off, Imam looks to punch it through the off side but it goes off the inner half through square leg for a couple.
Length and outside off, Zaman goes hard at it. Ends up mistiming it to mid off for a quick run.
FOUR! Nicely played! That was nothing more than a forward push. Length and on middle, Zaman plants his front foot forward and punches it past mid on.
This one is angled into the batsman, Imam works it through square leg for one.
On the off pole, Imam strides forward and keeps it out. So despite the boundary, only 5 from the over.
Good length on off, it is defended onto the ground.
Slightly outside off, Imam looks to punch but it goes off the outside edge and down to third man for one.
FOUR! Just over! First boundary of the innings. Imam says enough of blocking. He dances down the track and then hits it just over the fielder at mid off for a boundary.
Back of a length on off, Imam stands tall and blocks it out.
On the pads again, it is worked to mid-wicket.
A single to end another good over for England. Shorter in length and on middle, it is pulled through mid-wicket for a single.
Another dot, this one is bowled on off, it is blocked out.
BEATEN! Just outside the off pole, swings away just a little. Imam looks to push it through the off side but the ball whizzes past the outside edge.
Goes back to bowling it outside off, it is left alone.
WIDE! Tries to bowl this one on a straighter line and then get it to move away. The ball though keeps on angling down the leg side and it has been wided.
That has swung but the line is way too outside off, it swings away further. Imam plays inside the line and lets it go.
Good fielding! Slightly short and outside off, Imam guides it to point where the fielder dives to his right and stops it.
David Willey to take the second new ball from the other end.
A beauty to end the first! Lands it around off and then gets it to angle away. Zaman plays inside the line and gets beaten. A good first over by Woakes.
A big swing and a miss! Slightly shorter and around off, Zaman looks to hoick it against the angle but misses.
A misfield means another single. This is guided towards point. Roy looks to stop it with a tumble but does not do so cleanly.
A quick run there by Zaman to get off the mark! Back of a length delivery on off, FZ taps it with soft hands towards cover.
Back of a length around off, Zaman goes back and blocks it out.
Pakistan are underway! A little too straight and Imam works it towards wide mid on for a single.
We are back for the chase. Imam-ul-Haq and Fakhar Zaman will open the batting for Pakistan. The first new ball is in the hands of Chris Woakes.
